limitations: This 48-row published dataset was previously benchmarked in this repository. The split is retrospective and is not fresh prospective untouched evidence.
One 100m site, two published directions, three days and peak windows; 16 correlated means on the test day are not 16 independent vehicle samples.
Published means are not original vehicle-level speed records. One source speed/time discrepancy is retained and tested separately.
Exact survey geometry and canonical corridor mapping remain unverified. No network or current-time prediction is supported.
The selected family is frozen before day3, but model comparison on only one validation day has substantial selection uncertainty.
The calculated PKJI reference speed is not used as measured free flow; no severity or travel-time ground truth is manufactured.
No uncertainty-coverage, camera counting, queue inference or 15/30/60-minute operational accuracy claim follows from this diagnostic.

protocol.mode: Rolling one-hour-ahead prequential forecasting of existing arcs

protocol.preprocessing_refit: Train slice during selection; train + validation only during final fit
protocol.holdout_protocol: One frozen final holdout, no feature or hyperparameter changes based on its scores
protocol.online_lag_updates: Observed earlier validation/test counts may enter later predictions; no multi-day open-loop claim

selection.selection_metric: validation MAE, then deterministic name tie-break
selection.final_refit: Refit only the best validation trained candidate on train + validation; holdout targets excluded; retain it even if a baseline wins selection

limitations: Foreign-city transfer benchmark; not a trained or validated Batam congestion predictor.
Only 61 calendar days and 24 smallest active arc IDs, not a representative city or seasonal sample.
No independently checked per-row detector fault flags; nonmissing source counts can still contain measurement error.
Zero publication latency is assumed because actual detector publication latency is unavailable.
Autocorrelated road-hour errors are not independent vehicle samples; no IID confidence claims.
No holidays, incidents, weather or road-change data were acquired for these measurements.
No generalization test to previously unseen roads; all holdout arcs occur in training.
The held-out period is now consumed for this fixed experiment; changing features after seeing these scores requires a new untouched holdout.
Interval calibration shares the model-selection validation slice and is not a separate conformal calibration set.
Hourly detector flow is neither exact camera vehicle count nor measured road speed, travel time, queue length or independently labeled congestion severity.
The serialized scikit-learn model is a local trusted research artifact; retain source attribution/license and exact environment when reusing it.

split.final_holdout_source: TRANSSET, two North Carolina highway locations, USA
split.holdout_session_provenance: Not released; filename ordinals are not timestamps. Frames may be correlated.
split.author_split_handling: All Visaitech frames are development data; leave-whole-video/duplicate-component-out validation replaces the author split without crossing video groups

validation.selection_metric: Mean MAE across whole source-video/duplicate-component held-out groups

features.resize: 128x128 bilinear RGB feature input only; aspect ratio not preserved; no new image files
features.preprocessing: Ridge StandardScaler fit separately within each training fold, then full Visaitech development only; ExtraTrees sees raw fixed features

limitations: 80 images form a tiny development/transfer diagnostic, not a robust learned vehicle detector.
Global/cell pixel summaries can learn background, viewpoint, illumination or redaction rather than vehicles; there are no predicted bounding boxes.
South Asian dashcam and US aerial highway views differ sharply; taxonomy also shifts from wheeler groups including bicycles to eight car/truck classes.
Targets count supplied vehicle boxes, not newly audited true vehicle counts or unique vehicles across frames.
Original Visaitech source videos may themselves share a capture session; video-disjoint and hash checks do not prove independence.
TRANSSET session/video mapping is unavailable; no IID confidence intervals or independent-frame statistical significance is claimed.
No Batam, queue, line-crossing flow, speed, travel time, tracking or congestion labels are used or validated.
No holdout-driven tuning is permitted; this TRANSSET subset is now consumed for the fixed experiment.
No network calls, pretrained downloads, synthetic photos, crops or augmentation were used.

assumptions: Experimental candidate only; no serving model or road cost is changed.
No synthetic/modelled rows; provider training requires caller-verified rights.
Timestamp groups are separated with 60-minute purges before the next forecast origins.
Validation alone selects model configuration; final fit uses fit plus validation labels only.
Calibration alone determines interval radius; final test labels do not select or calibrate models.
Current, lag, trend and history inputs require observation and availability times at/before origin.
Fit, validation and calibration labels must arrive strictly before the next partition's earliest forecast origin.
Bare observation timestamps are an unverified availability assumption and cannot support promotion.
Intervals have no coverage guarantee under temporal dependence.
Speed-ratio scores floor at .05 and cap at 95; speed error is also reported in km/h.
Travel-time and image vehicle-count/queue labels are absent; those tasks are not trained here.
Locations match rounded coordinates, not directed road edges; all-street coverage is not established.
